names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 26 aprilie, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Vasilevs, Episcopul Amasiei».

Read out of saint.gr's page for 26 Απριλίου, which heads him «Άγιος Βασιλέας Ιερομάρτυρας Επίσκοπος Αμασείας» and then writes the name throughout as Βασιλεύς — «Ο Άγιος Ιερομάρτυς Βασιλεύς έζησε κατά τους χρόνους του βασιλέως Λικινίου» — with the rank words and the see left off; the page glosses it «ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥΣ (βάσις + λαός) = ο θεμελιωτής της ευτυχίας του λαού».

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 26. април ст. ст., „Свешт. муч. Василије еп. Амасијски.“ Свешт. муч. is the `hieromartyr` this folder already carries in `types`, and еп. Амасијски is the see, which it keeps in `office`; `honorific.js` composes both back. The heading gives no epithet, so the bare forename is the whole of the Serbian form. Four other folders already hold it; the fold was measured and the row is in the batch's commit message.

The name link behind the day’s line is page 369, titled «Святитель Василий Амасийский, епископ, сщмч.»; the rank words «Святитель», «епископ» and «сщмч.» are stripped per BRIEF.md §4, leaving the two words the day’s own line also uses, «Василия , еп. Амасийского». Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'амасиискии василии' has no other holder, where the Serbian «василије» fold holds five and the Greek «βασιλευσ» two.

feast.note: A SECOND RUSSIAN DAY, READ AND RECORDED, AND THE ROW DID NOT MOVE. This calendar's 30 апреля ст. ст. names him again, as «Обретение мощей сщмч. Василия , еп. Амасийского (IV).», the finding of his relics, and links the same life page life936 that the 26 апреля entry links. BRIEF-RUSSIAN §6 makes «Обретение мощей» a feast and not a folder, and BRIEF.md §4 gives a second day on one church no field but a note on that church's feast: so the day, the source, the year and the status here are exactly what they were before, and the four days between the two are the distance between a martyr's own day and the day his relics were found, both in the same Julian calendar. The 30 апреля page prints one hymn under his name, «Кондак священномученика Василия, епископа Амасийского» (глас 4), and IT IS THE SAME KONTAKION WORD FOR WORD that the 26 апреля page prints and that this folder already carries, so nothing was added. The 30 апреля line gives his century as «(IV)» where the 26 апреля line gave «ок. 323» and the Prologue gives 322; all three are inside the fourth century and `dates` were not touched again. NO YEAR IS GIVEN FOR THE FINDING, which is why no part of it is in `dates`.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 апреля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Василия , еп. Амасийского (ок. 323).»

attestations.note: The day’s first entry. A YEAR DISAGREEMENT, RECORDED AND NOT RESOLVED: this line heads him «ок. 323», about 323, where the folder holds 322 off the Охридски пролог’s „бачен у море, 322. год.“ The Russian life, life936, gives NO year for his own martyrdom at all — only «(+ 322)» for Glaphyra, who died before the order reached Amasea — so there is nothing here to narrow or widen with, and `dates` was NOT touched. The life is SHARED WITH `glaphyra`: its title is «Священномученик Василий, епископ Амасийский. Праведная дева Глафира» and the day’s third line links the same page. THE ACCOUNT IS SUBSTANTIALLY THE ONE THE FOLDER ALREADY HAD from doxologia, saint.gr and the Prologue, and it differs in four small places, each of which is now in the life: it names the second deacon «Фестим» where the folder has Theotimus; it has GLAPHYRA’S OWN LETTER to the empress fall into the emperor’s hands, where the Prologue has an imperial eunuch intercept it; it makes the trial turn on the offer of the HIGH PRIESTHOOD, «стать верховным жрецом», which he refused; and at Sinope the net cast «на счастье» of the two deacons brought up nothing, and only the net cast in the Name of God brought up the body, whose head had grown back on with nothing but a scar at the neck to show the sword. The day page prints ONE hymn under his name, «Кондак священномученика Василия, епископа Амасийского» (глас 4), which names Василие and «священномучениче», and it is on this folder now; the folder had one Greek troparion and no kontakion. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 26 aprilie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Vasilevs, Episcopul Amasiei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Βασιλέας Ιερομάρτυρας Επίσκοπος Αμασείας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it is plainly the same man: bishop of Amasea in Pontus, the protector of Glaphyra against Licinius, beheaded at Nicomedia, his body thrown into the sea and drawn up in a fishing net off Sinope by Elpidophorus and the deacons Theotimus and Parthenius and carried back to Amasea. **The Greek adds three things the Romanian life did not have.** It dates Licinius's reign «(307-323 μ.Χ.)» and puts his persecuting measures in «το έτος 322 μ.Χ.», the year of the denunciation — no year of the martyrdom itself is printed anywhere on the page, so this folder's empty `dates` were left empty rather than reasoned out of those two figures, and the writer may want to look at them. It names the relics: «Η Κάρα του Αγίου βρίσκεται στη Μονή Δοχειαρίου Αγίου Όρους», the skull at Docheiariou on the Holy Mountain, «Μία εκ των χειρών του Αγίου βρίσκεται στη Μονή Ιβήρων Αγίου Όρους», one of his hands at Iviron, and a fragment at the Lavra of Saint Alexander Nevsky in Saint Petersburg. And it says his synaxis was kept at the Great Church, where part of his body may have been preserved. It prints one apolytikion, proper to him and naming him, which is stored here; the day page also carries a separate entry for the finding of his relics, which is not a folder. The corpus's Basiliscus of Amasea is another man.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 09.05.2026 (26. април ст. ст.) — „Свешт. муч. Василије еп. Амасијски.“

attestations.note: The same passion the Romanian and Greek readings of this folder tell, in far fewer words and told from the emperor's side: Licinius, Constantine's brother-in-law, feigning Christianity until the whole East was given him to govern; the maiden of the empress's household he set out to defile; her flight to Amasea and her welcome by this bishop; the intercepted letter; and the bishop taken alone because she had died first. **It gives „322. год.“ for the beheading**, and since this folder carried no date at all, that is the date it now carries. The number agrees with saint.gr's and does not mean the same thing there: that page puts the persecuting measures and the denunciation of the bishop of Amasea in 322 and gives no year for the martyrdom. New from this book: the empress grieving and unable to turn her husband; the recovery of the body near **Sinope**, drawn out of the water with fishermen's nets at the showing of an angel; and the end of Licinius himself — beaten by Constantine, taken, and exiled to Gaul. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion, so this folder gains no hymn.

hymns.text: Ὡς Λειτουργὸς τοῦ Βασιλέως τῆς δόξης, τῷ παρανόμῳ βασιλεῖ ἀντετάξω, Ἱερομάρτυς ἔνδοξε παμμάκαρ Βασιλεῦ, ὅθεν τὸν αὐχένα σου, ἐκτμηθεῖς διὰ ξίφους, χαίρων προσεχώρησας, πρὸς οὐράνιον λῆξιν, ἧς καὶ ἠμᾶς δυσώπει μετασχεῖν, τοὺς εὐφημούντας τὴν ἔνθεον μνήμην σου.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος α’, Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, on the page of «Άγιος Βασιλέας Ιερομάρτυρας Επίσκοπος Αμασείας»

english.text: As a minister of the King of glory thou didst set thyself against the lawless king, O glorious hieromartyr, all-blessed Basileus; wherefore, thy neck cut through by the sword, thou didst pass over rejoicing to the heavenly portion. Entreat that we too may have a share in it, who praise thy godly memory.

hymns.text: Царево повеление преобидев,/ Царство Небесное получил еси, Василие,/ в немже ликуя,/ поминай нас, чтущих память твою,/ священномучениче.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Кондак священномученика Василия, епископа Амасийского», глас 4, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 26 апреля ст. ст.

english.text: Having set at nought the command of the emperor, thou hast received the kingdom of heaven, O Basileus; rejoicing therein, remember us who honour thy memory, O hieromartyr.

death.note: The Охридски пролог for 26. април ст. ст.: „После мука и тамнице блажени овај муж би посечен и бачен у море, 322. год.“ — the first year this folder has carried. saint.gr prints the same number for a different thing, the persecuting measures and the denunciation of the bishop, and gives no year for the martyrdom itself; doxologia's life dates him only by the reign of Licinius in the East.
